comments.author: Felix Arden
comments.body: Our Tidewater T2 consumable order that was due August 1st didn't arrive until August 4th — 4 days late. We managed by borrowing from our own par stock but it was closer than I'd like.

comments.author: Sam Okafor
comments.body: Sorry about that, Felix. Checking with distribution now on what caused the delay — will get back to you with a root cause once I hear back.

comments.author: Felix Arden
comments.body: Appreciate it. Just want to make sure it's not a pattern before our par levels get tighter next month.
